Name: We Love Doodles Professional Grooming Long Pin Dog Bath Brush, Large
Description: Treat your furry companion to a luxurious bath experience with the We Love Doodles Long Pin Dog Bath Brush, designed to make bath time more effective and enjoyable for both pet parents and their beloved pups. This large furbaby shampoo brush features uniquely designed, flexible bristles that work deep into your buddy’s coat to loosen dirt, remove shed hair, and evenly distribute shampoo for a thorough clean. The gentle massaging action stimulates the skin without causing irritation, leaving your dog with a cleaner, healthier, and noticeably shinier coat after every wash. Pamper your barking BFF with the soothing massage feature of this bath brush. The gentle yet effective massaging action not only relaxes your curious companion during bath time but also promotes healthy circulation, leaving them feeling rejuvenated and refreshed after each wash. Plus, the set includes two brushes, giving you a convenient backup or one to share with a fellow pet parent.
